brand_headline: A custody and operations platform for Uganda's prison service.
brand_body: Every facility keeps working offline first. Head Office sees the national picture the moment a facility reaches it.
onboarding_role_description: Most installations are a facility. You can start working straight away, with no connection to anything.
onboarding_role_facility_description: Operate a prison facility locally. You can connect it to Head Office later.
onboarding_role_hq_description: Operate the central system for managing connected facilities. No Pleadli Cloud code is needed to start.
onboarding_role_workstation: This is another computer in a facility that already has one
onboarding_workstation_description: On the node computer, open Settings, Device and node, and make an enrolment code. Enter the node's address, its fingerprint and the code here.
onboarding_workstation_failed: Could not connect to the node
setup_identity_description: Tell Pleadli which prison this is. It works fully on this computer, with no connection to anything else.
setup_conventions_description: How badges, prisoners and documents are numbered here. Each shows an example as you type.
setup_admin_description: The Officer in Charge. This account can add every other officer.
setup_signin_description: A facility in a controlled setting may want something quicker than a password. Choose what fits yours.
setup_ho_description: This facility is set up and ready. Connecting it to Head Office is optional, and you can do it any time from Settings.
setup_failed: Could not set up the facility
setup_failed_description: Nothing was saved. Check the details and try again.
setup_check_failed_description: This installation did not answer. Try again in a moment.
setup_facility_code_description: Printed on every document, and how Head Office recognises this facility. It cannot be changed after the first person is admitted.
setup_fact_jurisdiction_purpose: Legal thresholds, forms and terms follow this country's law. Other jurisdictions need legal work first and are not available yet.
setup_fact_language_purpose: Screens and printed documents. Other languages arrive with their translations.
setup_fact_timezone_purpose: Every date and time on a record or printout.
setup_badge_prefix_description: New badge numbers at this facility must start with it. Leave blank if badges here share no prefix.
setup_prisoner_numbers_description: {seq} is a counter with 4 digits. {year} is the year of admission.
setup_numbering_provisional: No official numbering format for Uganda Prisons was found, so this is a working suggestion. Set your own now. After the first admission it is fixed.
setup_document_prefix_description: Starts the number of every document and register this facility prints.
setup_admin_password_description: Administrators always sign in with a password, whatever the facility chooses for other officers.
setup_signin_hint: You can change this later in Settings, under Sign-in and security.
setup_request_sent_description: It will show as connected once Head Office approves it.
setup_err_code_required: Enter the facility code Head Office knows it by.
setup_err_code_format: {label} can be up to {max} letters, digits, - . or /.
setup_err_pattern_required: Enter a pattern, or use the suggested one.
setup_err_badge_prefix: Badge numbers at this facility start with {prefix}.
setup_err_password_match: The two passwords are not the same.
hqsetup_identity_description: Tell Pleadli which organisation this is. Head Office works fully on this computer, and needs no code from Pleadli Cloud.
hqsetup_conventions_description: The badge and document numbers used at Head Office. Each shows an example as you type.
hqsetup_admin_description: The Head Office administrator. This account can add every other Head Office officer.
hqsetup_failed: Could not set up Head Office
hqsetup_name_placeholder: For example, Uganda Prisons Service Headquarters
hqsetup_code_description: Printed on every document Head Office issues. It cannot be changed after Head Office has issued records.
hqsetup_verify_note: Verifying this installation with Pleadli Cloud is optional and can be done later in Settings, under Organisation.
settings_owner_facility_hint: Decided and changed here, by an administrator of this facility.
settings_owner_organisation_hint: Decided and changed here, by an administrator of Head Office.
settings_owner_device_hint: Applies to this computer only, not to the facility.
settings_owner_head_office_set_hint: Head Office decides this. It cannot be changed here.
settings_owner_head_office_default: Set by Head Office, you may change
settings_owner_head_office_default_hint: Head Office suggests this. This facility may change it.
settings_about_facility: The name, code and place printed on every document.
settings_about_organisation: The name and code Head Office prints on every document, and its standing with Pleadli.
settings_about_numbering: How badges, prisoners and documents are numbered, and uniforms.
settings_about_language: The language and time zone of screens and printed documents.
settings_about_appearance: Light, dark, or match the system.
settings_about_sign_in: How officers sign in, and what protects the data on this computer.
settings_about_head_office: Connect to Head Office, see what is shared, and disconnect.
settings_about_network: How reachable Head Office is, and which facilities are waiting to connect.
settings_about_backup: Copies of this installation's data, and restoring from them.
settings_about_device: This computer's role, its address, and other computers that may connect.
settings_appearance_description: Light, dark, or match the system.
settings_language_description: Screens and printed documents. Other languages arrive with their translations.
settings_jurisdiction_description: Legal thresholds, forms and terms follow this country's law. It is fixed at setup.
settings_timezone_description: Every date and time on a record or printout.
settings_security_description: The database on this computer is not yet encrypted on disk. Keep it in a controlled room and turn on the operating system's disk encryption.
settings_verify_no: Not verified yet. Head Office works fully without it.
settings_verify_failed_description: Check the code and try again.
settings_profile_hint: Printed on every document this installation issues.
settings_verify_hint: Optional. Head Office works fully without it.
ui_you_have_unsaved_changes_discard_them: You have unsaved changes. Discard them?
ui_pick_what_you_re_adding_then: Pick what you’re adding, then fill it in.
ui_search_prisoners_by_name_or_national: Search prisoners by name or national ID…
ui_start_typing_to_find_a_prisoner: Start typing to find a prisoner.
ui_go_to_something_in_pleadli_prisons: Go to something in Pleadli Prisons
ui_navigate_the_prison_start_a_procedure: Navigate the prison, start a procedure, or search by name, national ID, reference.
ui_search_by_name_national_id_reference: Search by name, national ID, reference… or jump to an area
ui_dev_builds_only_switch_between_facili: Dev builds only: switch between Facility and Head Office
ui_dev_builds_only_flips_this_installati: Dev builds only. Flips this installation between Facility and Head Office without a real activation code.
ui_waiting_for_this_installation_to_star: Waiting for this installation to start
ui_it_is_starting_or_restarting_nothing: It is starting or restarting. Nothing is lost, and this screen carries on by itself.
ui_the_page_you_re_looking_for: The page you're looking for doesn't exist.
attachments_save_this_record_first_then_: Save this record first, then you can attach documents.
attachments_void_this_document_kept_on_r: Void this document (kept on record, with your reason)
attachments_documents_are_never_deleted_: Documents are never deleted. This one stays on record, marked void with your name and the reason below.
auth_policy_could_not_save_the_sign_in: Could not save the sign-in settings
auth_policy_accounts_that_sign_in_with_t: Accounts that sign in with their badge alone will need a password or PIN. Give each one from Officers.
connectivity_connected_does_not_mean_eve: Connected does not mean everything is visible. Only what is listed here is exchanged, and nothing is sent unless it has changed.
connectivity_stops_this_facility_exchang: Stops this facility exchanging anything with Head Office. Every record, officer, backup and audit entry here stays exactly as it is.
connectivity_local_prison_work_carries_o: Local prison work carries on as before. Changes made from now on stay on this machine, and connecting again begins with a full exchange. Head Office keeps its own record of this facility until it removes it.
court_productions_the_court_order_points: The court order points at discharge. Open Discharge from the prisoner file.
court_productions_now_record_the_sentenc: Now record the sentence from the warrant.
court_productions_order_reference_condit: Order reference, conditions, anything the file should carry
court_productions_no_one_is_currently_on: No one is currently on remand.
custody_if_it_cannot_be_verified_the: If it cannot be verified, the instrument is kept as awaiting rectification (s.58(4)).
custody_enter_the_date_the_sentence_star: Enter the date the sentence starts
custody_check_the_warrant_the_date_the: Check the warrant: the date the sentence runs from, which may be earlier than admission.
custody_days_of_remission_lost_to_a: Days of remission lost to a disciplinary finding (s.85).
custody_required_the_earlier_entry_is_ke: Required. The earlier entry is kept, marked superseded.
documents_this_person_has_not_been_disch: This person has not been discharged, so there is no certificate to print.
documents_that_kind_of_document_is_not: That kind of document is not available.
documents_not_issued_yet_it_is_numbered: Not issued yet. It is numbered and recorded in the facility register when you print it.
documents_not_yet_issued_it_is_numbered: Not yet issued. It is numbered and recorded in the facility register when it is printed.
documents_that_transfer_could_not_be_fou: That transfer could not be found.
documents_the_receiving_prison_matches_t: The receiving prison matches this digest against the dossier it imports.
facilities_the_address_head_office_gave_: The address Head Office gave you, or paste its pairing code. It is remembered for next time.
facilities_another_installation_is_alrea: Another installation is already connected as this facility. If Head Office approves this request, that connection is replaced.
facilities_check_the_address_and_try_aga: Check the address and try again.
facilities_head_office_has_no_facility_w: Head Office has no facility with that number. Check it, or ask Head Office to add the facility to its roster.
facilities_register_it_with_a_pairing_co: Register it with a pairing code instead
facilities_with_a_valid_code_you_connect: With a valid code you connect straight away. Without one, Head Office approves the request.
facilities_head_office_could_not_registe: Head Office could not register this facility
facilities_the_pairing_code_may_have_bee: The pairing code may have been used or expired. Ask for a new one.
facilities_head_office_did_not_accept_th: Head Office did not accept this sync
facilities_head_office_could_not_be_reac: Head Office could not be reached
facilities_pick_this_facility_from_head_: Pick this facility from Head Office's list. Connecting never blocks local work.
facilities_an_administrator_of_this_faci: An administrator of this facility can connect it to Head Office.
facilities_makes_this_head_office_reacha: Makes this Head Office reachable from anywhere. These are the credentials the tunnel will use; saving them does not start a tunnel by itself.
facilities_leave_blank_to_keep_the_curre: Leave blank to keep the current token
facilities_that_does_not_look_like_a: That does not look like a Pleadli pairing code
facilities_paste_the_code_head_office_ga: Paste the code Head Office gave you
facility_check_the_details_and_try_again: Check the details and try again.
facility_the_number_of_places_the_facili: The number of places the facility is approved for. Occupancy is measured against it.
health_events_recording_this_never_chang: Recording this never changes custody status. The prisoner stays legally under detention throughout.
legal_no_court_productions_are_scheduled: No court productions are scheduled. Book one from the prisoner file or Add record.
node_no_backups_are_being_made_set: No backups are being made. Set a recovery passphrase below to start.
node_no_backups_in_that_folder_yet: No backups in that folder yet.
node_check_the_values_and_try_again: Check the values and try again.
node_leave_blank_for_the_default_better: Leave blank for the default. Better: a folder on another drive
node_write_the_passphrase_down_and_keep: Write the passphrase down and keep it somewhere safe that is not this computer. Without it a backup cannot be restored, and nobody can recover it for you. Changing it only affects backups made afterwards.
node_this_replaces_the_facility_s_data: This replaces the facility’s data with the backup’s. Work done since the backup is moved aside, not deleted. The backup is fully checked first, and the swap happens when the application restarts.
node_opens_the_backup_completely_and_che: Opens the backup completely and checks every file against its checksum, without changing anything. A backup you have not verified is a guess.
node_that_backup_did_not_check_out: That backup did not check out
node_name_the_computer_make_a_one: Name the computer, make a one-time code, and enter it on that computer.
node_name_this_workstation_e_g_registry: Name this workstation, e.g. Registry PC
node_the_database_failed_its_safety_chec: The database failed its safety check, so nothing has been opened or changed. Restore a backup to continue. The damaged database is kept aside, not deleted.
node_the_backup_checked_out_and_is: The backup checked out and is ready. Restart the application to finish: it swaps the database in before anything opens.
node_that_folder_could_not_be_read: That folder could not be read
node_no_pleadli_backups_found_in_that: No Pleadli backups found in that folder.
notifications_nothing_here_yet_it_is_qui: Nothing here yet. It is quiet.
notifications_there_is_no_text_with_this: There is no text with this message.
notifications_optional_kept_with_the_mes: Optional. Kept with the message when you mark it actioned or dismiss it.
notifications_for_an_official_communicat: For an official communication received on paper, by phone or in person.
notifications_for_example_production_ord: For example, production order for 3 October
notifications_optional_reference_numbers: Optional. Reference numbers, what was asked, who took it.
numbering_could_not_fetch_head_office_de: Could not fetch Head Office defaults
numbering_numbering_is_taken_only_while_: Numbering is taken only while nobody has been admitted. Colours you set yourself are kept.
numbering_facilities_that_have_not_set_t: Facilities that have not set their own numbering take this when they connect. A facility that has already admitted someone keeps what it has.
numbering_shown_at_facilities_that_have_: Shown at facilities that have not chosen their own colour for a category.
numbering_what_each_facility_last_report: What each facility last reported when it fetched these defaults.
numbering_has_not_fetched_the_defaults_y: Has not fetched the defaults yet
numbering_letters_digits_and_spaces_plus: Letters, digits, / - . _ and spaces, plus the parts above. At most 40 characters.
numbering_a_yearly_counter_starts_again_: A yearly counter starts again at 1 each January and needs a year in the pattern.
numbering_optional_label_for_example_yel: Optional label, for example Yellow tunic
obligations_who_was_told_what_was_sent: Who was told, what was sent, what was decided
officers_signs_in_with_the_badge_alone: Signs in with the badge alone
officers_no_password_or_pin_each_such: No password or PIN. Each such sign-in is recorded. Never for administrators.
officers_leave_blank_to_keep_the_current: Leave blank to keep the current one
officers_can_manage_accounts_workstation: Can manage accounts, workstations, backups and the audit trail
officers_this_account_is_not_posted_to: This account is not posted to a facility. Set one when editing the account.
prisoner_photos_take_the_photos_with_a_p: Take the photos with a phone
prisoner_photos_scan_the_code_or_open_th: Scan the code or open the link on a phone connected to this facility network. Each photo it takes appears in the slots on this screen.
prisoner_photos_turn_on_serving_workstat: Turn on serving workstations to use a phone as a camera.
prisoner_photos_qr_code_for_the_phone_li: QR code for the phone link
prisoners_e_g_ward_3_whatever_this: e.g. Ward 3, whatever this facility calls its own areas
prisoners_mark_when_a_prisoner_was_admit: Mark when a prisoner was admitted before the committed warrant arrived. Their status stays 'Convicted'; release is blocked until the documents are received.
prisoners_offence_triable_only_by_the_hi: Offence triable only by the High Court
prisoners_log_a_visitor_and_supervising_: Log a visitor and supervising officer.
prisoners_log_a_hospital_referral_return: Log a hospital referral, return, or mental-hospital transfer.
prisoners_log_enrolment_in_vocational_tr: Log enrolment in vocational training, prison industries, or prison farming.
prisoners_log_a_complaint_raised_via_the: Log a complaint raised via the Human Rights Committee ("Mukutano") mechanism.
prisoners_record_a_uvtab_trade_testing_o: Record a UVTAB trade-testing or similar external assessment outcome.
prisoners_record_what_further_action_was: Record what further action was taken.
prisoners_each_time_this_facility_has_he: Each time this facility has held this person.
prisoners_everything_on_this_file_newest: Everything on this file, newest first.
prisoners_the_warrants_and_orders_this_p: The warrants and orders this person is held under.
prisoners_a_warrant_order_or_other_docum: A warrant, order or other document that arrived for this person.
prisoners_from_the_warrant_of_conviction: From the warrant of conviction or committal.
prisoners_dates_are_computed_check_them_: Dates are computed. Check them against the warrant.
prisoners_what_the_court_decided_at_this: What the court decided at this production.
prisoners_remand_a_court_date_should_alw: Remand: a court date should always be booked
prisoners_computed_with_one_third_remiss: Computed with one-third remission. Check the warrant.
prisoners_record_the_sentence_to_compute: Record the sentence to compute it
prisoners_nothing_is_open_for_this_perso: Nothing is open for this person.
prisoners_take_each_view_with_a_camera: Take each view with a camera or upload a file. A new photo replaces the one on file for that view.
prisoners_computed_from_the_remand_perio: Computed from the remand period once the threshold applies
prisoners_record_belongings_placed_in_th: Record belongings placed in the officer in charge's custody (s.62).
prisoners_scans_and_files_attached_to_th: Scans and files attached to this person's record.
prisoners_record_return_at_release_or_di: Record return at release or discharge (s.62(3)).
property_records_e_g_phone_wallet_with_u: e.g. Phone, wallet with UGX 40,000, wristwatch
property_records_e_g_handed_to_next_of: e.g. Handed to next of kin
reception_a_front_photo_and_both_sides: A front photo and both sides, for identification. These can also be taken later from the prisoner's profile.
reception_receive_a_person_under_a_legal: Receive a person under a legal instrument. Nothing is recorded until you make the decision on the last step.
reception_verify_the_document_the_person: Verify the document the person arrived under (s.58). Check the court seal or the authorised signature, and that the particulars match the person.
reception_seal_or_signature_verified_par: Seal or signature verified, particulars match
reception_required_to_accept_without_it_: Required to accept. Without it, the person can only be accepted with the document pending, or refused.
reception_who_signed_which_seal_any_disc: Who signed, which seal, any discrepancy noticed
reception_identity_and_the_legal_categor: Identity and the legal category the person is held under.
reception_no_standard_prisoner_number_fo: No standard prisoner number format was confirmed in research.
reception_offence_triable_only_by_the_hi: Offence triable only by the High Court
reception_sets_the_mandatory_bail_thresh: Sets the mandatory-bail threshold: 180 days if High Court only, otherwise 60 days (Art. 23(6)).
reception_dates_are_computed_from_this_a: Dates are computed from this and shown as computed. Check them against the warrant.
reception_defaults_to_the_date_received_: Defaults to the date received. Change it if the warrant counts from an earlier date.
reception_search_on_reception_s_62_1: Search on reception (s.62(1)) and the person's visible condition.
reception_describe_any_visible_injury_or: Describe any visible injury, or write none observed
reception_record_what_the_person_says_in: Record what the person says, in their words
reception_record_the_complaint_as_made_d: Record the complaint as made. Do not assess it here.
reception_money_clothes_and_effects_take: Money, clothes and effects taken into the Officer in Charge's custody (s.62). One line for each item.
reception_next_of_kin_and_emergency_cont: Next of kin and emergency contacts. Offer to notify them of the imprisonment.
reception_health_screening_as_soon_as_po: Health screening as soon as possible, and the written information the person must receive.
reception_who_screened_and_anything_that: Who screened, and anything that needs follow-up
reception_coordination_only_clinical_det: Coordination only. Clinical detail is not kept here.
reception_rules_discipline_and_the_compl: Rules, discipline and the complaints procedure (s.58(5)).
reception_where_the_person_is_accommodat: Where the person is accommodated. Check separation rules for category, sex and age.
reception_anything_else_the_next_officer: Anything else the next officer should know
reception_accept_accept_with_a_document_: Accept, accept with a document pending, or refuse. This is recorded with your name.
reception_it_becomes_an_open_item_on: It becomes an open item on Today until the instrument is recorded.
reception_say_exactly_why_reception_is_r: Say exactly why reception is refused
releases_this_prisoner_could_not_be_foun: This prisoner could not be found.
releases_record_the_authority_clear_the_: Record the authority, clear the gates, and discharge. If a gate cannot be met in time, the Officer in Charge can authorise an exception.
releases_order_warrant_or_entitlement_re: Order, warrant or entitlement relied on, with reference
releases_for_example_the_court_order_and: For example the court order and its reference, or the entitlement date computed from the sentence.
releases_s_83_requires_discharge_on_enti: s.83 requires discharge on entitlement before noon. This time is at or after 12:00 East Africa Time. The discharge can still be recorded, and the late time will be noted.
releases_a_gate_that_is_not_met: A gate that is not met blocks discharge unless the Officer in Charge authorises an exception. That is the next step.
releases_exception_authorised_by_the_off: Exception authorised by the Officer in Charge
releases_the_officer_in_charge_is_respon: The Officer in Charge is responsible for discharge as soon as someone is entitled to release (s.83), so a gate must never keep a person in custody against a lawful order. The OIC may authorise discharge without these gates being met. The reason is recorded, and each waived gate becomes a task to regularise afterwards.
releases_why_the_discharge_cannot_wait_f: Why the discharge cannot wait for these gates
releases_you_hold_the_exception_authorit: You hold the exception authority, so this discharge will be authorised in your name.
releases_your_role_cannot_authorise_an_e: Your role cannot authorise an exception. The Officer in Charge enters their own badge number and password here.
releases_some_steps_are_not_finished_yet: Some steps are not finished yet. Use the list on the left to complete them.
requests_not_linked_to_a_specific_prison: Not linked to a specific prisoner
session_create_the_first_administrator_a: Create the first administrator account for this Head Office.
session_create_the_first_account_it_is: Create the first account. It is the Officer in Charge and administrator, and can add every other account afterward.
session_check_your_badge_number_and_pass: Check your badge number and password.
session_sign_in_to_prisons_head_quarters: Sign in to Prisons Head Quarters.
session_sign_in_with_your_badge_number: Sign in with your badge number to continue.
session_leave_the_password_blank_if_your: Leave the password blank if your account signs in with the badge alone.
today_what_is_held_what_is_owed: What is held, what is owed, and what is in flight.
today_the_name_goes_on_a_transfer: The name goes on a transfer dossier, and approved capacity is what occupancy is measured against.
today_set_it_in_the_facility_profile: Set it in the facility profile.
today_nothing_is_due_the_queue_is: Nothing is due. The queue is clear.
today_no_exceptions_documents_sentences_: No exceptions. Documents, sentences and transfers are in order.
transfers_no_transfers_yet_start_one_fro: No transfers yet. Start one from a prisoner's file, or receive one that arrived by file.
transfers_the_transfer_is_confirmed_and_: The transfer is confirmed and this stay is closed.
transfers_only_a_transfer_still_being_pr: Only a transfer still being prepared can be cancelled. The reason is kept in the audit trail.
transfers_why_is_it_not_going_ahead: Why is it not going ahead?
visits_no_visits_recorded_for_this_priso: No visits recorded for this prisoner yet.
visits_no_visitors_are_approved_for_this: No visitors are approved for this prisoner yet. They are added when a visit is scheduled.
visits_record_the_reason_it_stays_on: Record the reason. It stays on the visit and in the audit trail.
visits_photographic_id_and_a_search_come: Photographic ID and a search come before anyone goes in.
visits_photographic_id_checked_against_t: Photographic ID checked against the visitor
visits_leave_empty_if_the_visitor_brough: Leave empty if the visitor brought nothing.
visits_refused_id_or_search_turn_away: Refused ID or search? Turn away
visits_close_each_one_complete_it_mark: Close each one: complete it, mark a no show, or cancel it.
visits_no_visits_are_booked_for_the: No visits are booked for the next two weeks.
visits_privileged_visit_seen_within_sigh: Privileged visit: seen within sight but not within hearing of an officer. Nothing said is recorded.
visits_choose_the_date_and_time_of: Choose the date and time of the visit.
visits_every_visitor_needs_a_photographi: Every visitor needs a photographic ID.
visits_it_waits_for_the_officer_in: It waits for the Officer in Charge to authorise it.
visits_no_one_is_approved_for_this: No one is approved for this prisoner yet. Find a registered visitor or add a new one.
visits_search_by_name_id_number_or: Search by name, ID number or phone
visits_choosing_someone_here_approves_th: Choosing someone here approves them for this prisoner too.
visits_if_this_id_is_already_registered: If this ID is already registered, that visitor is reused instead of added twice.
visits_seen_within_sight_but_not_within: Seen within sight but not within hearing of an officer. Nothing said is recorded, so no notes are kept.
visits_this_is_a_special_authorization_o: This is a special authorization or falls outside visiting hours, so it is sent to the Officer in Charge to approve first.
visits_an_officer_in_charge_can_authoris: An Officer in Charge can authorise an exception.
visits_anything_the_gate_or_supervising_: Anything the gate or supervising officer should know
visits_defaults_follow_the_published_vis: Defaults follow the published visiting hours and party limit, which are not confirmed against the Regulations. Set what this facility applies.
visits_anything_outside_these_days_and_h: Anything outside these days and hours is sent to the Officer in Charge to authorise.
route_facilities_every_prison_facility_o: Every prison facility on this Head Office's roster, and whether it is connected.
route_facilities_register_a_facility_abo: Register a facility above, or generate a pairing code below. A facility appears here the moment it exists.
route_facilities_no_facility_is_waiting_: No facility is waiting to connect.
route_facilities_this_facility_is_alread: This facility is already connected. Approving replaces the current connection, which stops syncing.
route_facilities_could_not_issue_an_acti: Could not issue an activation code
route_facilities_give_this_to_the_facili: Give this to the facility. Entering it when connecting links the installation at once, without waiting for approval. It works once.
route_facilities_that_code_is_invalid_or: That code is invalid or has expired
route_facilities_a_facility_not_on_the_r: A facility not on the roster? Generate a pairing code
route_facilities_a_one_time_code_valid_f: A one-time code valid for 24 hours. The facility pastes it, types its own details and registers itself. Nothing is emailed from here.
route_facilities_could_not_generate_a_pa: Could not generate a pairing code
route_index_this_account_can_administer_: This account can administer the facility but cannot open prisoner records.
